messages:
Maya R (CSM): Hey team — heads up: Clearwave is seeing a spike in tail-latency and tokens burned during onboarding flows. Renewal check in 6 weeks, want to propose proactive changes.
Jordan L (CSE): Ugh. Any specific endpoints/payloads?
Maya R (CSM): chat.generate / summarizer route. Large context users. P95 latency ~ 420ms, costs up 27% since last week.
Omar V (Performance Eng): Could try int4 + compact kv cache for that route. Also route lower-confidence shorter prompts to compact model. :thinking: 
Priya S (SRE): Do we have model quality evals on int4 for their prompt set? Need to avoid regressions before a canary.
Jordan L (CSE): I ran a quick diff overnight — hallucination rate unchanged on our sample subset, BLEU-ish metrics hold. Will upload raw evals.
Maya R (CSM): Customer open to a small perf pilot. Want proposal with rollback plan and expected $/req savings for the execs.
Omar V (Performance Eng): Proposed config:
```
route: /chat/generate
policy:
  - match: short_prompt
    model: redwood-compact-1.1-int4
  - default: redwood-llama-2-13b
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  kv_quant: int4
```
Priya S (SRE): For canary, suggest 5% traffic to dedicated compact pool in us-east1, gradual 1->5->25 over 2h with metrics gates (p95, error-rate, regen-rate).
Jordan L (CSE): I'll coordinate with Clearwave PM for test window Tues 10-12 PST. Maya — can you own customer comms?
Maya R (CSM): Yep. I'll send calendar + success criteria. Also adding renewal note to account file.
deploy-bot: canary started — id: cw-compact-canary-20240307 — 5% traffic
Omar V (Performance Eng): Early numbers: p95 down to 320ms, token cost -18% on canary.
Priya S (SRE): No error spike, CPU and GPU utilization normal. Observability dashboard: https://console.redwood/obs/clearwave/canary
Jordan L (CSE): If metrics hold at 25% we should consider defaulting the short_prompt policy. Customer feedback loop scheduled.
Maya R (CSM): Great. If we can show 15-20% cost reduction and stable quality that helps renewal conversation.
Jordan L (CSE): I'll compile a one-pager for execs with numbers and rollback steps.
Maya R (CSM): Thanks all :pray: — will update thread after customer sync.
deploy-bot: canary ended — status: success — final p95: 315ms — cost delta: -19%
Maya R (CSM): Official thumbs up from Clearwave PM on pilot. Moving to staged rollout next week.
